maddeler.e:
أحترف (form VIII)
# أَحْتَرِفُ (ʔaḥtarifu) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# أُحْتَرَفُ (ʔuḥtarafu) /ʔuħ.ta.ra.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# أَحْتَرِفَ (ʔaḥtarifa) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# أُحْتَرَفَ (ʔuḥtarafa) /ʔuħ.ta.ra
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
